stepBody: For whatever reason, we decide to add Imperial units to our dataset, which we will now call humans. That is, we add the columns height (in) and weight (lb), where humans['height (in)'] $$=$$ humans['height (cm)'] / $$2.54$$ and humans['weight (lb)'] $$=$$ humans['weight (kg)'] * $$2.2$$.\n\nWhich of the following sets of columns are linearly independent and have a span that is equal to the span of the columns of humans? Select all that apply.##figure1.gif##
